purpose: Render and QA three symbol-safe 1920x1080 silent visual masters for the revised foundational CM lessons. Narration, mux, publication, and unrelated episodes are excluded.

render_contract.font: embedded DejaVu Sans/Mono with pre-render cmap audit

resource.mismatch_policy: Delete immediately without rendering if exact owned resource checks fail.

authorization_ceiling.retry_policy: No second pod create. Resume inside the one owned pod only; a failed or deleted pod requires a new exact proposal.

transport_and_cleanup.credential_reference: existing RUNPOD_API_KEY environment variable; never print, persist, bundle, or transmit its value except as the RunPod API authorization header
transport_and_cleanup.upload: one hash-bound bundle via SFTP; verify SHA-256 before extraction
transport_and_cleanup.download: one bounded result ZIP plus SHA-256; reject unsafe paths or unexpected files

authorization_effect: Approval authorizes only one Secure A5000 pod/create for the exact three silent masters in this bundle, up to $1.25. It does not authorize narration services, publication, other episodes, commit, or push.
